title: macOS CI via SDK relay
desc: GitHub Actions workflow validating WKAppBot portable .NET split on macOS
steps: Trigger: GitHub Actions workflow runs on macOS-latest via workflow_dispatch or repository_dispatch (type: macos-test)
Environment: Runner macos-latest, .NET 8.0.x, Clones kiexpert/WKAppBot private core with WKAPPBOT_CORE_PAT secret

Workflow Steps: (1) Checkout wkappbot-sdk repository (2) Setup .NET 8.0.x environment (3) Clone WKAppBot core repo with depth=1 (4) Print .NET environment via dotnet --info (5) Conditionally build Portable.slnf if available
Output handling: Success shows Build completed successfully, Failure shows exit code N with tail last 20 lines, Not available gracefully exits 0
Public Log Hygiene: Token never echoed, only summary to console, no paths disclosed
To trigger: gh workflow run macos-test.yml --repo kiexpert/wkappbot-sdk

PHASE 1 SPEC (WKAppBot core team, owner 2026-09-30): Build portable .NET split for macOS. (1) Survey csharp/src projects for net8.0 portability, output .tmp/macos/portable-survey.md. (2) Design Portable.slnf filter + multi-target (net8.0;net8.0-windows10.0.22621.0) on portable projects. (3) Implement #if WINDOWS seams or interface boundaries. (4) Proof: Windows build green + dotnet build csharp/Portable.slnf -f net8.0 succeeds. (5) Wire macos-test.yml to build Portable.slnf. Rules: foreground sectors, one item per commit by pathspec, wkpush.sh -m, origin verification.

PHASE 1 COMPLETE (2026-09-30, run 36676298999): macOS CI PASS. Root cause of CI failure: <TargetFrameworks> containing net8.0-windows* causes MSBuild to refuse project evaluation on non-Windows hosts unless EnableWindowsTargeting=true is set. Fix: added to csharp/Directory.Build.props. Also: latestPatch->latestFeature in global.json (precaution), direct stdout in workflow Build step (no set-e+redirect conflict). All 4 portable projects build net8.0 clean: Abstractions, PluginContract, Android, Example.Plugin.

Phase 1 COMPLETE (2026-09-30): csharp/Portable.slnf (JSON, 4 projects: Abstractions, PluginContract, Android, Example.Plugin), all 4 .csproj multi-targeted (net8.0;net8.0-windows10.0.22621.0), AdbClient.cs #if WINDOWS seam, Directory.Build.props EnableWindowsTargeting=true, global.json rollForward:latestFeature. macOS CI run 36676298999 PASSED (arm64, .NET 8.0.425, 33s). Root cause of earlier failures: EnableWindowsTargeting missing caused MSBuild to refuse project evaluation on non-Windows hosts even with -f net8.0. Phase 3 (Win32/UIA + AXUIElement backend) is out of Phase 1 scope per portable-survey.md; needs new spec.

DONE: skill git mirror pushed to origin/main at commit a0fec39c60 (2026-09-30). File at bin/wkappbot.hq/skills/wkappbot-sdk/macos-ci-via-sdk-relay.skill.json with Phase 1 completion steps (9-10) verified on origin. (bin/wkappbot.hq/skills/wkappbot-sdk/macos-ci-via-sdk-relay.skill.json) is on origin/main at v1.4. Done when: git show origin/main:..skill.json shows Version 1.4 in JSON.
